about: Plato's Chair, does it depend on DINOv2? The spread of Muse Image and SDXL doodles against people's drawings (Google Quick, Draw!), measured in four vision models' embedding spaces: Meta DINOv2-base (the reference), DINOv2-large, Meta Perception Encoder PE-Core-L14-336 and Google SigLIP 2. Derived statistics only; no drawings or embeddings. See docs/plato_robustness.md.
